title: Find why a builder's Bash-script write of 64 test-path files passed
why: A builder that writes tests defeats the review; decision builders-cannot-edit-tests.
source: lane guard-tables-per-section via coordinator 11:03 CST Nov 12
note: Incident: a builder in lane guard-tables-per-section wrote 64 test-path files through a Bash script, and no guard stopped it. The lane suspects the guard sees Write and Edit only. Triage read main (hooks/guard.py header, 11:04 CST Nov 12): the builder-test-edit guard judges Write and Edit; the builder-diff guard judges a builder's Bash commit or push by its diff, and SubagentStop refuses its first stop. So the gap is one of: the builder never committed and the spawner did; the second stop passed; or is_builder_test_rel missed those paths. First act: get the commit and the 64 paths from the lane, then judge which. Ready, no lane.
